module purpose: neorv32_cpu_pmp stores per-region PMP configuration and address state via CSR writes, returns that state on csr_o, and checks the current instruction or load/store access address and privilege against the configured regions to raise fault_o.

use-case flows.value: per-region PMP configuration byte, including R/W/X permission bits, address-matching mode, and lock bit, written from CSR data when a pmpcfg CSR is addressed
per-region lock state that blocks later pmpcfg and pmpaddr updates and removes the machine-mode bypass for permissions
per-region PMP address register written from CSR data when a pmpaddr CSR is addressed and the entry is unlocked
stored PMP configuration and address state returned on csr_o according to the CSR address
current access address and privilege are selected, region matches and permissions are computed, and a violation chain is formed
registered access-fault result on fault_o, suppressed when cpu_debug is asserted
pmpcfg, pmpaddr, addr_mask, and fault_o cleared to zero when rstn_i = '0'

conceptual assets.concept: Per-region PMP configuration state, including permission bits, address-matching mode, and lock state
conceptual assets.reasoning: The configure and lock flows store PMP configuration in pmpcfg only when the addressed pmpcfg word is written and the entry is not locked (lines 113-145, especially 127). The stored bits come from CSR write data for R/W/X and lock (lines 129-131,145), sanitize unsupported address modes to mode_off_c (lines 133-140), and force reserved bits to zero (line 143). This state is then consumed to decide region matching and permissions (lines 303-339) and is read back through cfg_rd/cfg_rd32 to csr_o (lines 203,236,190). Integrity is Established because corrupting these bytes changes the enforced permissions, matching mode, or lock behavior; availability is also Established because the bytes are held until rewritten or reset (line 125) and are conditionally returned on csr_o (line 190).

The address configure flow stores pmpaddr from CSR write data when the addressed pmpaddr entry is written and unlocked (lines 157-176, especially 170,173,176); for non-last entries, line 172 further qualifies updates when the next entry is a locked TOR entry. The stored address state is used to reconstruct CSR readback (lines 207-219, then csr_o at line 192), to build the NAPOT mask when NAP_EN is enabled (line 257), and in the address comparisons that feed region matching (lines 285,295,296). Integrity is Established because corrupting this state changes which addresses match a region and what address value is read out; availability is also Established because pmpaddr is retained until rewritten or reset (line 168) and is conditionally readable on csr_o (line 192).

conceptual assets.concept: PMP access-fault decision for the current fetch, load, or store
conceptual assets.reasoning: The operate flow first selects the checked access address and privilege: acc_addr chooses ctrl_i.pc_nxt or addr_ls_i (line 244) and acc_priv chooses ctrl_i.cpu_priv or ctrl_i.lsu_priv (line 245). Region match is computed from the configured mode and address comparisons (lines 301-314), permission allow is computed from access type, privilege, and configuration bits (lines 318-342), and the fail chain forms the first matching denial plus the default non-machine-mode case (lines 351-354). The report flow registers `fault_o <= (not ctrl_i.cpu_debug) and fail(0);` at line 363. Integrity is Established because corruption changes whether the module flags an access as violating the configured PMP rules; availability is also Established because fault_o is updated on each rising edge when reset is inactive (lines 358-363).
